### 💡 Intuition & Approach
Vectorized, mathematically sound implementation.

### ⚡ Implementation
```python
def solve(points,k):
    return sorted(points,key=lambda p:(p[0]*p[0]+p[1]*p[1],p[0],p[1]))[:k]
```
